name: pi-skills
description: Pi skills for design discussions, technical writing, and Git commit workflows

scripts.test: node --test 'tests/**/*.test.js' 'tests/**/*.test.ts' '.pi/skills/verify-project/scripts/*.test.ts' && mise exec -- uv run --locked --python python python -B -m pytest
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings skills tests extensions .pi/skills/verify-project/scripts && mise exec -- ruff check skills/commit
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && mise exec -- uv run --locked --python python ty check skills/commit
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --fix skills tests extensions .pi/skills/verify-project/scripts && mise exec -- ruff check --fix skills/commit
scripts.format: biome format --write . && mise exec -- ruff format skills/commit
scripts.format:check: biome format . && mise exec -- ruff format --check skills/commit
